name: VERISMO
source:
10 years ago, Vittoria's father was murdered by a worker in their orchard. It's now 1925, and the man makes a sudden reappearance in her life as a wealthy Don.

When she meets a wayward carnival performer who also has a bone to pick with the Don, the two scheme to teach him a lesson, at a deadly price. 

[From [url=https://staranisegames.itch.io/verismo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
10年前，维多利亚的父亲在果园被一名工人谋杀。现在是1925年，这个男人突然以富有的唐身份重新出现在她的生活中。

当她遇到一位任性的嘉年华表演者时，他也对唐有意见，两人计划以致命的代价给他一个教训。

[来自[url=https://staranisegames.itch.io/verismo]itch.io[/url]]
